editorial_contributions.text: There are two well-known ways of defining the fractional chromatic number of a graph \(G\). One of them defines this parameter as the infimum of a certain linear program, the other makes use of set colorings of \(G\). In this note the author discusses the relationship of these two definitions and shows that they are equivalent if the fractional chromatic number of \(G\) is finite. Finally, he lists several interesting open problems with a particular emphasis on infinite graphs.
